scope: Read-only installed CLI/SDK and durable-host inspection; no provider mutation or paid launch

verified.cancel_behavior: Default graceful=false; RPC return does not establish terminal state. Poll exact job ID until SUCCESS, ERROR or CANCELLED.
verified.graceful_behavior: Optional --graceful uses configured SIGTERM/60s shutdown; do not confuse this with total job lifetime.
verified.refreshable_auth: Installed CLI/yc and existing authenticated profile are verified on Mac only. Fixed YC_IAM_TOKEN is non-refreshable.

not_verified: DataSphere CLI, yc and authenticated profile on a durable controller host
Persistent external timer/service armed before submission
Live forced cancellation and terminal confirmation against a campaign job
required_before_paid_submit: User supplies current finite DataSphere allocation
Verify durable controller host and refreshable auth without printing/copying credentials
Arm external3600-second-from-submission deadline and persist exact newly-created job ID atomically
Cancel only the uniquely identified campaign job and verify terminal state
